rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within the threshold.
Verifies the generated output CSV data matches established critical golden records
Verifies that all StatVars meet freshness requirements (within 2 years of current year).

params.query: SELECT CAST(MIN(MaxDate) AS VARCHAR) AS latest_date FROM stats
params.condition: latest_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(latest_date AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INT) >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2
